script.cover_1: Okay, will see. The junior waits all day for more.
script.payoff: A reply that says what happens next ends the waiting.
script.caption: Silence after submitted work feels like a verdict. Send this to the manager whose replies are always short.
script.lands: The junior may wonder if the work was good, bad or never opened.
script.better: Got it. I will review it by 5 pm and tell you.
script.why: It says what happens next and when, so the junior is not left waiting.
